newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice futures end lower, commercials sell.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice futures end lower, commercials sell.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended lower on Tuesday, hit by late commercial selling, traders said.
"Volume was pretty thin until just before the close and then it picked up," a trader said. "We had some long liquidation and Cargill was a new short seller."
Traders blamed the downward move on technical correction following Monday's strong gains. Fundamental factors were unchanged, they said.
Rice ended 22 to 7-1/2 cents per cwt lower with September down 18 at $9.25. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 250 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 652 lots.
